players.product: 2D Penning micro-trap trapped-ion QPUs (scaling with Infineon)

quarterly_data.signal: Supplier Rhonexum: ZuriQ and Rhonexum signed a multi-year commercial framework agreement under which Rhonexum will supply cryogenic integrated-circuit technologies and customization services to ZuriQ, which will evaluate them for its trapped-ion quantum computing roadmap; the agreement has already resulted in a first quantity of Rhonexum's inaugural product scheduled for delivery by the end of this year, and gives ZuriQ privileged access to selected Rhonexum technologies. CEO Pavel Hrmo: it 'gives us access to specialized cryogenic electronics technologies that support our future deployment roadmap.'
